design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 (self_pay_visit_packages, category package)

0. DRAW AND SCOPE SNAPSHOT
draw_counts.py --task 1 printed: {"task": 1, "key": "env_0032_physical_therapy_clinic_network/self_pay_visit_packages/1", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 6]}. Both problems take 6 factors: package_ext_reinstatement_charge (6) and package_ext_cancellation_refund (6, root).
Occupied by task 0: package_ext_installment_catch_up, package_ext_unfreeze_extension, package_ext_renewal_purchase, package_ext_household_transfer and their four tools (subjects: installment payments/credits, unfreezing, purchase/activation, transfers). Claimed here: the reinstatement (subject package_reinstated + its fee payment and visit credit) and the patient-confirmed cancellation for a refund (package_cancelled, package_visits_refunded), tools reinstate_visit_package_76109996 (agent) and confirm_package_cancellation_a8d08ce2 (owner=user). No policy, tool or subject overlaps task 0; nothing is left unclaimed (6 policies, 6 tools, all called).

1. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST
Priya Nadeau asks to cancel her package and be refunded for unused visits. The records show the package already expired on 2026-09-17 and its 5 unused visits were removed; the refund rule says no refund is worked out until the package stands active again with those visits credited back. The agent must find that the only write producing that state is a reinstatement (window: 30 days from the expiry date, day 19 today), price the reinstatement charge from six rules across the package ledger, the series history, her plan of care and her membership, hand the cancellation to the patient and compute a refund from six more rules (used-visit value switched by her new insurance, admin-fee waiver, forfeit charge, reinstated cap, installment service fee, handling charge). An agent that skips the reinstatement computes 505.00 (no cap, no handling charge) and cancels an expired package; one that reads only the standard methods computes 35.00 and 451.00.

2. PROBLEM-TREE CARD
Root package_ext_cancellation_refund (confirm_package_cancellation_a8d08ce2, owner user). One edge: cancellation_refund -> package_ext_reinstatement_charge; kind value_input; gate cap_value; form state; prerequisite sentence (negated direction - a refund is 'not worked out until'): "No refund is worked out until the package stands active again with the visits removed at its expiry credited back." Condition: status active and a package_visits_credited entry of credit kind reinstatement restoring the visits of the package_visits_expired entry. Resolver reinstate_visit_package_76109996 (agent). False at frozen_time: visit_packages.<K>.status = expired, visits_remaining = 0, package_events.<expired>.visits = 5. Only the reinstatement write returns an expired package to active with a reinstatement credit (unfreezing acts on frozen packages, installment credits on active ones), so the state singles out one write.
Four-point test: connective 'not ... until'; waited-on side is a record-visible state (status and a reinstatement credit); no tool/id/code token; scope exact (the visits removed at its expiry). Derivation: sentence + records (expired, 5 removed) + the reinstatement rule ('returns it to active status, credits back the visits removed at its expiry') -> reinstate.
Deletion sensitivity (calc.py, skip {9}): refund 284.00 -> 505.00. value_input edges 1 >= max(1-1, 1). Topological order: reinstatement, cancellation. The owner=user write is the patient's own confirmation of the cancellation (base: 'A refund needs the patient's own confirmation of the cancellation').
No user hint: the persona's reinstatement line is a passive reaction to the agent's explanation. Tools block nothing: neither tool reads status or the window.

3. BASE-INVARIANT CARD
- Reinstatement (package_reinstated, package_payment_received, package_visits_credited): package_expiry_and_reinstatement gate reinstatement_window - anchor visit_packages.expiry_date 2026-09-16 (day zero), not_after, variants.reinstatement_window_days 30 (Complete tier), calendar days, inclusive; 2026-10-05 is day 19 (allowed; day 30 = 2026-10-16 allowed, day 31 refused). Reinstated at most once (no earlier reinstatement credit). New expiry = 2026-10-05 + reinstatement_extension_days 30 = 2026-11-04. Restores the 5 visits removed at expiry. Overwrite declared on 'Reinstatement needs the reinstatement_fee paid first;' (the charge replaces the flat fee). package_evt_payments_and_crediting (policy_scope): card accepted; payments never exceed price + reinstatement fee (1236.00 + 27.25).
- Cancellation (package_cancelled, package_visits_refunded): package_evt_refunds (policy_scope for these subjects; the full_refund_window gate applies to package_refund_issued, which this task does not write - issuing waits on approval). Complete tier prorated_refund_allowed true; purchase 2026-03-20 is far past the 14-day full-refund window; the patient's own confirmation is the user tool. Overwrite declared on the prorated-refund sentence. Reinstatement fees are never part of the money paid toward the price (base sentence kept).

4. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
Package K (Complete 12, M54.50): installments 618.00 (2026-03-20) and 618.00 (2026-04-19) by card with 6-visit credits; visits used 2026-03-23, 03-26, 03-30, 04-06, 04-13, 04-20; forfeit 2026-04-09 (no-show; the 2026-04-02 late cancellation used the grace of 1); expiry entry 2026-09-17 removed 5. Series SN (Standard 45-Minute, package-funded, cancelled 2026-07-08 funding_ended): 10 booked = 6 attended + 1 late cancellation + 1 no-show + 2 clinic cancellations (04-16, 04-23); two misses in 60 days stay under the release threshold of 3, and package appointments carry no fees. Plan PN (Commercial PPO, active, M54.50, opened 2026-07-08) - the coverage that replaced the package. Membership PW (Wellness Plus, active since 2026-08-15, 10%).

5. FACTOR CARDS (tier; evidence; baseline figure)
reinstatement_charge (27.25; all-baseline 35.00): lapse_scaling 19 days -> 150%, baseline 11.50; member_reduction active Wellness Plus 10%, baseline 32.50; restoration_charge (method) 5 restored -> 4.00 each = 20.00, baseline 7.25; clinic_disruption_credit (series) 2 -> 20.00, baseline 47.25; coverage_credit (plan, multi-source) active same-diagnosis plan opened in validity -> 15.00, baseline 42.25; use_adjustment 6/12 used -> credit 5.00, baseline 32.25. Near-miss: the 2026-04-02 cancellation is a patient late cancellation, not a clinic cancellation.
cancellation_refund (284.00; all-baseline 451.00 = the base formula 1236.00 - 6 x 125.00 - 35.00): used_visit_value (method, plan, multi-source) package rate 103.00, baseline 262.00; admin_fee_waiver (series) 0.00, baseline 249.00; forfeit_charge (parameter: share 1 / 0.5 / 0 of the used-visit value) no-show forfeit -> share 1 = 103.00, baseline 387.00; unused_visit_cap reinstated 5 x 103.00 x 80% = 412.00, baseline 490.00; installment_service_fee 2 payments 10.00, baseline 294.00; reinstated_handling_charge 15.00, baseline 299.00. Near-miss: the 27.25 reinstatement-fee payment is a package payment but never part of the money paid toward the price.

6. PERSONA DESIGN
A payroll specialist, calm and note-taking. Opening = cancel and refund unused visits. Credentials verbatim (3365550189, 1988-11-03, ZIP 27103 if asked). She roughly remembers five visits left and does not know dates. Passive reactions: asks once whether a reinstatement still leaves her better off, then agrees and pays by card; confirms the cancellation herself with the agent's figures; closes when told it is confirmed. No other asks.

7. STANDARD SOLUTION
0 find_customers(phone) - 1 verify(DOB, phone) - 2 find_visit_packages - 3 find_package_events(K) - 4 find_appointment_series - 5 find_series_events(SN) - 6 find_care_plans - 7 find_wellness_memberships - 8/9 unlock + call reinstate (27.25, card, 5 visits, 2026-11-04) - 10/11 unlock_user + call_user confirm cancellation (284.00, 5 visits).

8. VERIFICATION
Per-task gates --task 1: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (29/29 closure rows), SOLVABILITY OK (3 base gates), COMPUTE OK (2 computations, 12 factors), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK. calc.py printed reinstatement 27.25 (baseline 35.0; per factor 11.5, 32.5, 7.25, 47.25, 42.25, 32.25) and refund 284.0 (baseline 451.0; per factor 262.0, 249.0, 387.0, 490.0, 294.0, 299.0); skipping step 9 -> 505.0.
Revision: the first draft of the edge effect claimed the cap would fall to 0.00 without the reinstatement; the run showed no cap applies at all (505.00), so the effect texts were corrected.

9. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT
From the refund rule the agent sees the wait on an active package with its expired visits back; the package history shows expiry with 5 removed; the reinstatement rule gives 35.00 x 150% x 90% + 20.00 - 20.00 - 15.00 - 5.00 = 27.25 and a new expiry of 2026-11-04; the refund rule then gives min(1236.00 - 618.00, 412.00) - 0 - 103.00 - 10.00 - 15.00 = 284.00 with 5 unused visits. Matches gold.

10. DIFFICULTY-LEVEL CLOSING RECORD
Union of scopes: task 0 {installment_catch_up, unfreeze_extension, renewal_purchase, household_transfer} + task 1 {reinstatement_charge, cancellation_refund} = all 6 extended policies; tools 4 + 2 = all 6 task tools; pairwise disjoint. Every task calls an owner=user tool (transfer; cancellation confirmation). Final gate run without --task: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (suite means branches 54.5, steps 16.0; history_rows_max 35; branches_max 71), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK; check_traceability waits for the published KB.


11. REWORK ROUND 2 (policy-task audit, first revision)
- F-3 (SOURCE-FACTOR RED, forfeit_charge labelled method): its tiers only substitute a multiplier. Change - new binding forfeit_share (1 where a no-show forfeit exists, 0.5 where all forfeits are late cancellations, 0 otherwise); the factor is now effect parameter deciding forfeit_share, and forfeit_charge = forfeited visits x used-visit value x forfeit_share is plumbing. The computation keeps its honest method factor used_visit_value (5 parameter / 1 method). Values unchanged: refund 284.00, forfeit-factor baseline 387.00, all-baseline 451.00.
- O-1: the coverage credit now reads a same-diagnosis plan in discharged or closed status for coverage_credit_ended, as the rule states; Priya's plan is active, so 27.25 is unchanged.
- O-8 (used_visit_value): the coverage tier equals the fall-through only on the Post-Surgical 18 tier, whose standard valuation is already the package rate; no task world holds that tier. Left unchanged - see round-2 report.
- Gates after rework: full block green.
user_scenario:
You are Priya Nadeau, 37, a payroll specialist in Winston-Salem, calling on your afternoon break. Last March you bought a twelve-visit self-pay package for your lower back at the Stratford Road clinic and paid for it in two card payments. In July your new job's insurance started, and since then your back therapy has been covered under that plan at the same clinic, so you stopped using the package after April. You want to cancel the package and get back the money for the visits you never used. You open with something like: "Hi, I bought one of your prepaid visit packages and I'd like to cancel it and get a refund for the visits I didn't use." You are calm and organised and you take notes.

To identify yourself you give your phone number, 3365550189, and your date of birth, 1988-11-03 (you say November 3, 1988); if a third detail is wanted you give your ZIP code, 27103. You think about five visits were left but you are not sure, and you ask the agent to check; you do not know any reference numbers and you have not kept track of the package's dates.

If the agent explains that the package has to be reinstated before it can be cancelled and tells you what that costs, you ask once whether that still leaves you better off, and once the agent has answered you agree and pay it by card. You do not want to keep using the package or to buy anything else, and you want no other changes to your account.

You want to confirm the cancellation yourself. When the agent hands the cancellation to you to confirm, you do it with exactly the package, refund amount and number of unused visits the agent gives you, and you read back what it shows. Once the agent tells you the cancellation is confirmed and the refund is on its way, you thank them and end the call. If the agent tells you no refund is possible, you ask them once to check again against your records, and then accept what they say.
